in_marathi.name: Ashvini
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashvini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Ashvini are the twin horse deities of the moon. They are associated with healing, fertility, and good fortune.

in_bengali.name: Ashvini
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ashvini একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, Ashvini are the twin horse deities of the moon. They are associated with healing, fertility, and good fortune.
